variables.name: PROJECT_ID
variables.title: Google Cloud Project ID
variables.description: Google Cloud Project ID bound to your Google SecOps tenant (for example, my-secops-project). Used for quota/billing header routing and MCP tool calls.

variables.name: REGION
variables.title: Google SecOps Region
variables.description: Google SecOps regional or multi-regional location prefix (for example, us, eu, europe-west2, or asia-southeast1). Resolves https://<REGION>-chronicle.googleapis.com/mcp.
